authority: teaching-case business contract; no change to existing Python/J35 defaults
native_metric_boundary: SystemResults.FTMO times interval width integrates to 2/6 mission-operation hours in the normal A01/A02 runs. This is separate from an independently clipped observation-window duration, and is not assumed to be a native cumulative OPHOURS counter.
window_boundary_status: 36-hour normal missions finish before the end. SIMPE boundary probes near mission return are rejected by native #204; result-collection-only probes are separate evidence. No cross-engine terminal cutoff equivalence is claimed.
identity_rule: Use stable business IDs; native one-SID/QTYPS=1 ordinal only identifies the sole instance in these cases, not a general tail mapping.
time_rule: SIMLOX ENLOG prints decimal hours of limited precision; compare exact model schedule and integers, and state a narrow precision bound for observed hours. Do not treat printed ties as internal scheduler priority.
acceptance: Independent AMD128 implementation and native first-sample evidence must both satisfy this same contract; matching seeds are not pairing evidence. No cross-engine status is claimed in this slice.
